description: Germany Kündigungsfrist under § 622 BGB: 4 weeks to the 15th or month end; employer notice 1 to 7 months to month end after 2 to 20 years; 2 weeks in a probation period of up to 6 months. Gives the last day of employment. Kündigungsschutzgesetz and collective agreements are not checked. Germany (§ 622 BGB), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax or legal advice.
